planner.description: Plan the next user story: analyze requirements, inspect codebase, and create a detailed task file in harness/tasks/. Use when you need to plan before building.

builder.description: Build/implement a planned user story from its task file. Writes code, runs tests, updates progress. Use after planning is done.

dispatch.description: Pick the next unstarted user story, plan it, build it, and update progress. Use 'dispatch next' to advance the project by one story.

progress.description: Show current development progress: completion %, epic status, active/blocked stories, and what's up next.
